reuse.why: Changes the rule inside the existing getExpectedScheduleAmount helper, so preview, posting, action sync and forecast pick it up; it does not route the remaining midpoint computations (getScheduledAmount, schedule-template.ts) through that helper.

duplication.why: The diff itself adds no duplicated logic, but leaves the parallel midpoint implementations in getScheduledAmount and schedule-template.ts in place, now disagreeing with the helper.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts where the tree defines the expected schedule amount.

scope.why: One expression change, comment updates and a focused test.

maintainability.why: Clean edit, but the codebase now has three different answers for a ranged schedule's amount (worst case in the helper, midpoint in getScheduledAmount used by the UI and in the budget schedule template), which a maintainer must discover.

bypasses_abstraction.where: The change goes through getExpectedScheduleAmount; the other midpoint copies predate it.

disguised_duplication.where: No logic is duplicated by the diff.

one_place.where: The new rule is only in getExpectedScheduleAmount (shared/schedules.ts); getScheduledAmount in the same file (used by SchedulesTable, Balance, mobile schedules, useScheduleEdit) and server/budget/schedule-template.ts still compute the midpoint themselves.
